title: ZGMF-X10A FREEDOM GUNDAM (VER. 2.0)
summary: Thanks to @Gundam.Info who uploaded SEED HD for free last month, I have gone through my favorite series again. Eventually, I wanted to purchase the Freedom GCP one instead (well it can wait) but there was none in stock. So Freedom 2.0 it is.
body: Thanks to @Gundam.Info who uploaded SEED HD for free last month, I have gone through my favorite series again. Eventually, I wanted to purchase the Freedom GCP one instead (well it can wait) but there was none in stock. So Freedom 2.0 it is.

The satisfaction of building a Bandai kit is undeniable. Everything perfectly goes together. Even when you made a mistake, you can just go back and fix it. This is also the first time I encounter dry decal. Personally, I am fond of it over water slide already. Easy to snap and adjust using a tape, firm and attach well to the surface without worrying about breaking it.
The bad side? Stickers. They don't fit into the model kit naturally and does not look good overall.
